title: Light background: user message text and hairlines nearly invisible, rules render heavy
observed: On the light profile the 'say hello' user text is near-background beige, the you-block has no visible surface, and the banner/input rules render as solid dark lines while the status hairline is faint.
expected: Background-aware tokens: body text dark on light, hairlines subtle but visible, user message legible.

fix.note: Text tokens meet contrast on light; surfaces match the design's separation; you-block raise and label hairlines visible. Still open: banner divider and input box rules render heavy black because app.go builds editor.Styles from fixed hexes before SetTerminalBackground runs (needs an editor SetStyles refresh after detection).
